about_the_game:
Zero Gravity Heroes: Reclaim the Shattered Cosmos

⚠️ THE UNIVERSE IS COUNTING ON YOU ⚠️

YEAR 2884: The Universal Defense Grid has fallen. As humanity’s last hope, you’re an Elite Quantum Pilot tasked with recovering fragments of an ancient space map scattered across 30 deadly sectors. Master three intense microgames to restore cosmic balance before time runs out!

YOUR MISSION:

  • PRECISION LANDING 🚀
    Navigate asteroid fields and security tunnels in a high-stakes lunar lander. Control thrusters, dodge hazards, and deactivate defensive grids to secure landing zones.

  • GROUND OPERATIONS ⛽
    Strap into your jetpack, scavenge fuel, and outmaneuver enemy patrols to power your escape rocket. One wrong move spells disaster!

  • ORBITAL DEFENSE 🔫
    Battle rogue AI guardians in tactical space combat. Outgun corrupted defense systems guarding each sector.

FEATURES:
✅ 3 Microgames, 30 Sectors: 90 escalating challenges across lunar lander, jetpack, and space shooter modes.
✅ 4+ Hours of Adrenaline: Race against time in zero-gravity chaos.
✅ Retro-Modern Visuals: Bold pixel art meets a cosmic sci-fi atmosphere.
WARNING: The universe’s stability hangs by a thread. Will you rise as a hero—or let chaos reign?
